notes: 156-page card; main body focuses on GPT-6 Astra; Appendix A (added 2026-09-22) covers GPT-6 Sol and Luna. Many capability results appear only in figures without readable numbers (ExploitBench Cap Percent, multiturn jailbreak curves, CoT controllability, HealthBench charts, hallucination rates, KernelGen/NanoGPT/PostTrainBench/MLE-Bench plots)—those were skipped. Static jailbreak Table 5 uses fractions with CIs; Table 27 repeats appendix values as percents for Sol/Luna. HealthBench Astra numbers were corrected on 2026-09-22; extraction uses the corrected table values. Risk decisions listed for Astra; appendix separately rates Sol/Luna High (not Critical) for cyber and bio/chem—mentioned in findings. SecureBio and Irregular treated as external testers. gpt-5.5-pro and gpt-5.6-Cyber left as rawModelName. Did not exhaust every inline number in long alignment/monitorability narrative sections; prioritized tables and preparedness numbers. Cap well under 600 results.
